The '''scar of remembrance''' was a vertical line of makeup that divided the lower lip. The head rulers of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] wore this "scar" as a symbol of remembrance for the less fortunate [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before the [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|Great Time of Peace]] which had been brought about by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]].<ref name="Episode I TVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
A mention of the scar of remembrance was cut from the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In a cut quest, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]] lost the ceremonial makeup used for creating the scar of remembrance and requested the player to retrieve it.<ref name="SWG" />
